instruction: Exit the laundry room and turn right.  Walk past the large plant and stand on the stairs.

calls.reason: Turn left to look for the laundry-room exit beside the closed door.
Align with the open doorway on the left.
Walk through the centered open laundry-room doorway.
Clear the doorway before turning right into the hall.
Turn right after exiting the laundry room to locate the plant and stairs.
Angle left around the open door toward the visible hallway.
Align with the hallway opening and advance toward the plant and staircase.
Continue along the clear hall toward the large plant.
Approach the stair area while keeping clear of the plant and floor vases.
Move alongside the plant to expose the foot of the staircase on the left.
Pass the plant on its left and turn toward the lower stair treads.
Aim through the clear space to the right of the doorframe toward the stair bottom.
Clear the near doorframe and approach the first stair beside the plant.
Move around the stair side wall to reach the open foot of the steps.
Turn to face up the staircase from its open bottom.
Move left of the staircase side wall to line up with the lowest tread.
Face along the stair treads from the bottom of the staircase.
Center the lower treads and advance onto the stair approach.
Align with the rising treads and step farther onto the staircase.
Adjust toward the center of the steps and take one short forward step.
Look back from the lower steps to verify the stair position and plant clearance.
The view shows the lower stair treads beneath the agent and the room below; stand here on the stairs.
